toolDefinitions.name: quantize-list
toolDefinitions.description: List the quantization jobs of the person you are talking to, newest first, including jobs started in the web page. A model can only control jobs it started.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-start
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new quantization job. A person confirms it in the approval card; nothing starts before that. A model can only control jobs it started.

name.description: A label for the job, 1 to 80 characters.

model.description: Model to quantize as a gallery or Hugging Face ID. A local path is refused.

backend.description: Quantization backend. The default is llama-cpp-quantization.

quantizationType.description: Quantization type, such as q4_k_m (lowercase letters, digits and underscores). The default is q4_k_m.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-status
toolDefinitions.description: Show the status of a quantization job that a tool started. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the quantization job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-stop
toolDefinitions.description: Propose stopping a quantization job that a tool started. A person confirms it. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the quantization job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-import
toolDefinitions.description: Propose registering the result of a quantization job that a tool started as a model. Administrators only. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the quantization job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

name.description: Name of the model, 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Leave out to let the engine choose.

ui.title: Quantization
ui.description: Shrink a model to a smaller quantized file, then import it so you can chat with it.
